title: map command: scratch worktree, runner and JSON format
goal: kbingest.py map REPO --rev REV creates a scratch git worktree at the commit, runs each mapper as an argument list with a timeout and a network-off environment, records tool name and version per language, writes one JSON map (packages, imports, entry points, notes) and removes the worktree; a missing toolchain is a note; a fake toolchain script on PATH in the tests proves timeout, missing tool and output parsing, and python -m ast in a subprocess maps Python files.
